# 🚀 Universal Smart Governor (USG) [![KernelSU Next Supported](https://shields.io)](https://github.com) [![Universal Architecture](https://shields.io)](https://github.com) [![Stable Release](https://shields.io)](https://github.com) An advanced, completely automated, and workload-reactive master performance engine for rooted Android devices. Built using native Linux kernel subsystem parameters and low-level Android abstraction layers, **USG** monitors active system load metrics to dynamically transform your device between an unthrottled gaming rig and a cool, battery-saving daily driver. Unlike basic "performance modules" that lock your processor to maximum frequencies 24/7 (causing immediate battery degradation and system instability), **USG calculates physical system load averages every 3 seconds** to activate optimizations dynamically across 8 critical hardware sectors only when your device demands it. --- ## 🌟 Features & Optimization Sectors * 🏎️ **Sector 1: Unrestricted CPU Frequency Lock** – Dynamically elevates internal governor permissions, locking all active core clusters to their maximum factory frequency profiles under load. * 🛑 **Sector 2: CPU Throttle Reversion** – Sweeps through low-level kernel thermal cooling slots (`cooling_device*`) and forcefully rewires the throttle state to zero, blocking the OS from slowing down a warm chip. * 🔓 **Sector 3: GPU Unclogging** – Disables global user-space Android surface thermal boundaries and toggles underlying flagship performance mode blueprints. * 🖼️ **Sector 4: UX & Texture Fluidity** – Offloads 100% of 2D/3D system layout composition directly to the graphics hardware, stripping processing weight off the CPU. * 🖥️ **Dynamic Refresh Rate Discovery** – Bypasses hardcoded screen thresholds. Queries the hardware display panel at runtime to automatically identify and lock the display to its maximum physical refresh limit (90Hz, 120Hz, 144Hz, etc.). * 📌 **Sector 5: Thread Affinity Locking** – Isolates the process IDs of the screen compositor and game engine threads (`surfaceflinger`, `composer`, `renderthread`), pinning them exclusively to high-performance cores. * 🧠 **Sector 6: Extreme Memory Tweaking** – Eliminates background swapping lag, aggressively flushes dirty data cache loops, defragments active layers, and creates a high-priority 16MB emergency buffer. * ⚡ **Sector 7: Storage UFS/NVMe Piping** – Expands storage block read-ahead limits to **512 KB** and raises request processing queues to **64 lanes** for near-instant map loads. * 🌐 **Sector 8: Zero-Delay Network Prioritization** – Bypasses cellular and Wi-Fi modem sleep states, expands core connection backlog paths to **5000 units**, and forces native Linux TCP low-latency pipelines for flat-line ping rates. --- ## 📱 Supported Devices Matrix The Universal Smart Governor is engineered with fallback logic that switches features automatically depending on the hardware platform it detects. | Device / Chipset Brand | Support Level | GPU / Thermal Uncapping | CPU / RAM / Storage Boost | Notes | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **POCO X6 Pro (duchamp)** | 🏆 **Native Tier** | Fully Uncapped (1400MHz) | Fully Uncapped | Developed and calibrated natively on this exact device layout. | | **Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO** | 🟢 **Full Support** | Fully Uncapped | Fully Uncapped | Integrates perfectly with underlying Xiaomi performance flags. | | **Snapdragon / MediaTek** | 🟢 **Universal** | Partial/Driver Native | Fully Uncapped | Universal core commands work flawlessly across all ARM64 platforms. | | **Google Pixel / Tensor** | 🟡 **Compatible** | Google Protected | Fully Uncapped | GPU remains bounded by Google's strict vendor firmware layer. | --- ## ⚠️ CRITICAL WARNINGS & CONFLICTS (Read Before Flashing!) Because USG directly modifies low-level kernel parameters, failure to read this section can cause performance drops or temporary phone bootloops: ### 1. The Multi-Module Conflict (Performance Overlap) **NEVER run USG at the same time as another performance module.** If you are currently running modules like **PerfMTK, FKM (Franco Kernel Manager tweaks), KTweaks, Magneto, or thermal disabler modules**, you must **uninstall them completely** and restart your device before flashing USG. Running them together will cause the two modules to overwrite each other's configurations every 3 seconds, leading to heavy micro-stutters, battery drain, and system freezes. ### 2. Physical Heat Warning USG completely unblocks the internal thermal boundaries of your phone when a heavy game or benchmark is running. This means **your phone will draw massive power and generate heat very quickly.** * **For Short Benchmarks (AnTuTu, Geekbench):** Safe to run standalone to see your score spike. * **For Prolonged Gaming (Genshin, PUBG, Emulators):** **You MUST use an external smartphone cooling fan.** Running unthrottled hardware profiles for extended periods without external cooling will permanently degrade your lithium battery health. --- ## 📸 Verification & Benchmarks Here is the real-world performance capability of **USG v1.1** running natively on the Poco X6 Pro (LineageOS 23.2). The automated workload calculation successfully uncaps the full processing layout, breaching the **1.68 Million+** score milestone while maintaining an active background daemon inside KernelSU Next.

## 🛠️ Step-by-Step Installation Guide ### Prerequisites 1. An Android device running any Custom ROM layout (e.g., LineageOS, Evolution X, PixelOS). 2. Fully unlocked bootloader. 3. Low-level root authorization granted via **KernelSU, KernelSU Next, or Magisk**. ### Installation Flow 1. Navigate to the **Releases** section of this repository and download the latest `Universal_Smart_Governor.zip`. 2. Open your **KernelSU Next** or **Magisk Manager** app on your phone. 3. Tap on the **Modules** tab on the bottom menu bar. 4. Click **Install from storage** (or the **+** symbol at the top). 5. Browse and select your downloaded `Universal_Smart_Governor.zip` archive. 6. The screen will flash terminal logs and read `Success`. 7. **Reboot your device immediately** to finalize the systemless deployment. --- ## 🕹️ Optional: Ad-Free Open-Source Live-Toggle Widget Setup

Instead of rebooting your phone to toggle the governor on and off, you can create seamless **invisible background widget switches** directly on your launcher home screen using Termux. This lets you pause the module mid-game with a single tap. ### 1. Requirements * Open-Source **Termux App** (F-Droid / GitHub) * Open-Source **Termux:Widget Addon** (F-Droid / GitHub) * *Note: Ensure your core Termux app and Widget addon are downloaded from the same source to avoid signature mismatch installation issues.* ### 2. Implementation Script Execution Open your **Termux** application on your phone, type `su` to grant it superuser access inside KernelSU, and then execute this script block to automatically construct the hidden background worker directories and shortcuts: ```bash # Create the specialized silent background worker directory mkdir -p ~/.shortcuts/tasks # Write the Performance Boost Trigger Shortcut cat << 'EOF' > ~/.shortcuts/tasks/USG_ON.sh #!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash su -c "rm -f /data/adb/modules/USG/disable" EOF # Write the Safe Daily Kill-Switch Shortcut cat << 'EOF' > ~/.shortcuts/tasks/USG_OFF.sh #!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash su -c "touch /data/adb/modules/USG/disable" EOF # Grant execution authorizations to both scripts chmod +x ~/.shortcuts/tasks/USG_ON.sh chmod +x ~/.shortcuts/tasks/USG_OFF.sh ``` ### 3. Adding the Widget to Your Home Screen 1. Long-press on an empty spot on your device's home screen wallpaper and select **Widgets**. 2. Scroll to the **Termux** section block. 3. Drag and drop the **Termux:Widget** option onto your active launcher page grid. 4. Tap the **`tasks/`** folder section listed inside the widget layout to reveal your execution keys: `USG_ON.sh` and `USG_OFF.sh`. 5. Tapping `USG_ON.sh` unblocks the engine instantly. Tapping `USG_OFF.sh` drops the device back to cool factory `schedutil` parameters silently behind the scenes within 3 seconds, without ever popping open an app screen layout over your game. --- ## 🔍 How to Verify the Script is Active You do not need to guess if the module is working. Connect your phone to your PC with USB Debugging enabled, open your command prompt, and check the automation logic using an ADB root shell: 1. Open your shell and gain superuser clearance: ```bash adb shell su ``` *(Ensure you tap "Grant" inside your phone's KernelSU manager app if prompted)* 2. Check if the automation engine has taken control of Android's thermal framework: ```bash dumpsys thermalservice | grep -i "override" ``` ### Reading Your Status: * ❄️ **Device at Normal Idle (Texting, browsing, UI sleeping):** The prompt will output `IsStatusOverride: false`. The governor leaves your hardware in its safe, cool, factory profile to save your battery. * 🔥 **Device Under Heavy Load (Gaming, AnTuTu running):** Launch your game and immediately run the command again on your PC terminal. It will automatically switch to **`IsStatusOverride: true`**, proving your standalone module has uncapped your hardware's full processing potential. --- ## 🪪 Project Metadata * **Project ID:** USG * **Lead Engineer:** Aniket * **Stable Version:** v1.1 * **License:** Open Source / MIT If this smart governor helped you dominate your benchmark records and smooth out your gaming stutters, please give this repository a ⭐!

🚀 Universal Smart Governor (USG)

![KernelSU Next Supported](https://github.com)

![Universal Architecture](https://github.com)

![Stable Release](https://github.com)

An advanced, completely automated, and workload-reactive master performance engine for rooted Android devices. Built using native Linux kernel subsystem parameters and low-level Android abstraction layers, USG monitors active system load metrics to dynamically transform your device between an unthrottled gaming rig and a cool, battery-saving daily driver.

Unlike basic "performance modules" that lock your processor to maximum frequencies 24/7 (causing immediate battery degradation and system instability), USG calculates physical system load averages every 3 seconds to activate optimizations dynamically across 8 critical hardware sectors only when your device demands it.

---

🌟 Features & Optimization Sectors

  • 🏎️ **Sector 1: Unrestricted CPU Frequency Lock** – Dynamically elevates internal governor permissions, locking all active core clusters to their maximum factory frequency profiles under load.
  • 🛑 **Sector 2: CPU Throttle Reversion** – Sweeps through low-level kernel thermal cooling slots (`cooling_device*`) and forcefully rewires the throttle state to zero, blocking the OS from slowing down a warm chip.
  • 🔓 **Sector 3: GPU Unclogging** – Disables global user-space Android surface thermal boundaries and toggles underlying flagship performance mode blueprints.
  • 🖼️ **Sector 4: UX & Texture Fluidity** – Offloads 100% of 2D/3D system layout composition directly to the graphics hardware, stripping processing weight off the CPU.
  • 🖥️ **Dynamic Refresh Rate Discovery** – Bypasses hardcoded screen thresholds. Queries the hardware display panel at runtime to automatically identify and lock the display to its maximum physical refresh limit (90Hz, 120Hz, 144Hz, etc.).
  • 📌 **Sector 5: Thread Affinity Locking** – Isolates the process IDs of the screen compositor and game engine threads (`surfaceflinger`, `composer`, `renderthread`), pinning them exclusively to high-performance cores.
  • 🧠 **Sector 6: Extreme Memory Tweaking** – Eliminates background swapping lag, aggressively flushes dirty data cache loops, defragments active layers, and creates a high-priority 16MB emergency buffer.
  • ⚡ **Sector 7: Storage UFS/NVMe Piping** – Expands storage block read-ahead limits to **512 KB** and raises request processing queues to **64 lanes** for near-instant map loads.
  • 🌐 **Sector 8: Zero-Delay Network Prioritization** – Bypasses cellular and Wi-Fi modem sleep states, expands core connection backlog paths to **5000 units**, and forces native Linux TCP low-latency pipelines for flat-line ping rates.

    • ---

    📱 Supported Devices Matrix

    The Universal Smart Governor is engineered with fallback logic that switches features automatically depending on the hardware platform it detects.

    | Device / Chipset Brand | Support Level | GPU / Thermal Uncapping | CPU / RAM / Storage Boost | Notes |

    | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

    | POCO X6 Pro (duchamp) | 🏆 Native Tier | Fully Uncapped (1400MHz) | Fully Uncapped | Developed and calibrated natively on this exact device layout. |

    | Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO | 🟢 Full Support | Fully Uncapped | Fully Uncapped | Integrates perfectly with underlying Xiaomi performance flags. |

    | Snapdragon / MediaTek | 🟢 Universal | Partial/Driver Native | Fully Uncapped | Universal core commands work flawlessly across all ARM64 platforms. |

    | Google Pixel / Tensor | 🟡 Compatible | Google Protected | Fully Uncapped | GPU remains bounded by Google's strict vendor firmware layer. |

    ---

    ⚠️ CRITICAL WARNINGS & CONFLICTS (Read Before Flashing!)

    Because USG directly modifies low-level kernel parameters, failure to read this section can cause performance drops or temporary phone bootloops:

    1. The Multi-Module Conflict (Performance Overlap)

    NEVER run USG at the same time as another performance module. If you are currently running modules like PerfMTK, FKM (Franco Kernel Manager tweaks), KTweaks, Magneto, or thermal disabler modules, you must uninstall them completely and restart your device before flashing USG. Running them together will cause the two modules to overwrite each other's configurations every 3 seconds, leading to heavy micro-stutters, battery drain, and system freezes.

    2. Physical Heat Warning

    USG completely unblocks the internal thermal boundaries of your phone when a heavy game or benchmark is running. This means your phone will draw massive power and generate heat very quickly.

  • **For Short Benchmarks (AnTuTu, Geekbench):** Safe to run standalone to see your score spike.
  • **For Prolonged Gaming (Genshin, PUBG, Emulators):** **You MUST use an external smartphone cooling fan.** Running unthrottled hardware profiles for extended periods without external cooling will permanently degrade your lithium battery health.

    • ---

    📸 Verification & Benchmarks

    Here is the real-world performance capability of USG v1.1 running natively on the Poco X6 Pro (LineageOS 23.2). The automated workload calculation successfully uncaps the full processing layout, breaching the 1.68 Million+ score milestone while maintaining an active background daemon inside KernelSU Next.

    🛠️ Step-by-Step Installation Guide

    Prerequisites

  • An Android device running any Custom ROM layout (e.g., LineageOS, Evolution X, PixelOS).
  • Fully unlocked bootloader.
  • Low-level root authorization granted via **KernelSU, KernelSU Next, or Magisk**.

    • Installation Flow

  • Navigate to the **Releases** section of this repository and download the latest `Universal_Smart_Governor.zip`.
  • Open your **KernelSU Next** or **Magisk Manager** app on your phone.
  • Tap on the **Modules** tab on the bottom menu bar.
  • Click **Install from storage** (or the **+** symbol at the top).
  • Browse and select your downloaded `Universal_Smart_Governor.zip` archive.
  • The screen will flash terminal logs and read `Success`.
  • **Reboot your device immediately** to finalize the systemless deployment.

    • ---

    🕹️ Optional: Ad-Free Open-Source Live-Toggle Widget Setup

    Instead of rebooting your phone to toggle the governor on and off, you can create seamless invisible background widget switches directly on your launcher home screen using Termux. This lets you pause the module mid-game with a single tap.

    1. Requirements

  • Open-Source **Termux App** (F-Droid / GitHub)
  • Open-Source **Termux:Widget Addon** (F-Droid / GitHub)
  • *Note: Ensure your core Termux app and Widget addon are downloaded from the same source to avoid signature mismatch installation issues.*

    • 2. Implementation Script Execution

    Open your Termux application on your phone, type su to grant it superuser access inside KernelSU, and then execute this script block to automatically construct the hidden background worker directories and shortcuts:

    # Create the specialized silent background worker directory
mkdir -p ~/.shortcuts/tasks

# Write the Performance Boost Trigger Shortcut
cat << 'EOF' > ~/.shortcuts/tasks/USG_ON.sh
#!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash
su -c "rm -f /data/adb/modules/USG/disable"
EOF

# Write the Safe Daily Kill-Switch Shortcut
cat << 'EOF' > ~/.shortcuts/tasks/USG_OFF.sh
#!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash
su -c "touch /data/adb/modules/USG/disable"
EOF

# Grant execution authorizations to both scripts
chmod +x ~/.shortcuts/tasks/USG_ON.sh
chmod +x ~/.shortcuts/tasks/USG_OFF.sh

    3. Adding the Widget to Your Home Screen

  • Long-press on an empty spot on your device's home screen wallpaper and select **Widgets**.
  • Scroll to the **Termux** section block.
  • Drag and drop the **Termux:Widget** option onto your active launcher page grid.
  • Tap the **`tasks/`** folder section listed inside the widget layout to reveal your execution keys: `USG_ON.sh` and `USG_OFF.sh`.
  • Tapping `USG_ON.sh` unblocks the engine instantly. Tapping `USG_OFF.sh` drops the device back to cool factory `schedutil` parameters silently behind the scenes within 3 seconds, without ever popping open an app screen layout over your game.

    • ---

    🔍 How to Verify the Script is Active

    You do not need to guess if the module is working. Connect your phone to your PC with USB Debugging enabled, open your command prompt, and check the automation logic using an ADB root shell:

  • Open your shell and gain superuser clearance:

    • ```bash

    adb shell

    su

    ```

    *(Ensure you tap "Grant" inside your phone's KernelSU manager app if prompted)*

  • Check if the automation engine has taken control of Android's thermal framework:

    • ```bash

    dumpsys thermalservice | grep -i "override"

    ```

    Reading Your Status:

  • ❄️ **Device at Normal Idle (Texting, browsing, UI sleeping):** The prompt will output `IsStatusOverride: false`. The governor leaves your hardware in its safe, cool, factory profile to save your battery.
  • 🔥 **Device Under Heavy Load (Gaming, AnTuTu running):** Launch your game and immediately run the command again on your PC terminal. It will automatically switch to **`IsStatusOverride: true`**, proving your standalone module has uncapped your hardware's full processing potential.

    • ---

    🪪 Project Metadata

  • **Project ID:** USG
  • **Lead Engineer:** Aniket
  • **Stable Version:** v1.1
  • **License:** Open Source / MIT

    • If this smart governor helped you dominate your benchmark records and smooth out your gaming stutters, please give this repository a ⭐!
